title: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified - News On AIR
description: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified  News On AIR
publisher.title: News On AIR
full_article:
India has rejected Nepal’s claim over Lipulekh Pass, termed it as a long-standing route for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra since 1954 and the Yatra through this route has been going on for decades. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal in a social media post said this in response to claims related to border issues made by Foreign Ministry of Nepal in the context of the annual Kailash Manasarovar Yatra.

He stressed that India’s position in this regard had been consistent and clear and this is not a new development. Mr Jaiswal pointed out that India has consistently maintained that such claims are neither justified nor based on historical facts and evidence. He stressed that such unilateral artificial enlargement of territorial claims is untenable. The spokesperson added that India remains open to a constructive interaction with Nepal on all issues in the bilateral relationship, including on resolving agreed outstanding boundary issues through dialogue and diplomacy.

title: Avalanche in Pakistan kills famed mountaineer Nirmal Purja and his fellow climbers - NPR
description: Avalanche in Pakistan kills famed mountaineer Nirmal Purja and his fellow climbers  NPR
publisher.title: NPR
full_article:
FILE - Nirmal Purja, one of the team members of the all-Nepalese mountaineering team that became the first to scale Mount K2 in winter, gestures as the team arrives at Tribhuwan International airport in Kathmandu, Nepal, Jan. 26, 2021. Niranjan Shrestha/AP hide caption toggle caption Niranjan Shrestha/AP

The celebrated climber Nirmal Purja and the nine other members of a mountaineering expedition group have died after they were caught in an avalanche on one of the highest peaks on earth.

"It is with profound sadness and immense heartbreak that we confirm that Mirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja tragically lost his life following the avalanche on Broad Peak," Purja's company Elite Expeditions said in a statement. Broad Peak is a 26,414 foot mountain in Northern Pakistan.

Far-Flung Postcards Greetings from an isolated region in northern Pakistan's Hindu Kush mountains

"We have also received confirmation that other members of the expedition sadly did not survive," the company said.

Purja, who was 43 years old and a British-Nepali climber, became world-renowned by breaking climbing records. In 2019, he was the first person to climb all 14 mountains world-wide with elevations above 8,000 meters (26,247 feet) in 6 months and 6 days. The feat was the subject of a Netflix feature documentary in 2021.

Purja also served for a decade in the UK's Special Boat Service, an elite special forces unit of the British military similar to the US Navy SEALs.

Sponsor Message

International team killed, including an American

The expedition included climbers from Oman, Nepal, Pakistan, China and the United States, according to Alpine Club of Pakistan.

The American mountaineer was 39-year old Mallory Geis of San Antonio, Texas, according to the Associated Press. In a social media post earlier this year she wrote about her decision to close her Pilates studio to pursue high altitude climbing.

"So here we go. Taking a giant leap of faith into the unknown to see where life goes. I have a sneaking suspicion there will be lots of helmets, harnesses, and crampons involved," Geis posted.

View this post on Instagram A post shared by Mallory Geis (@pursuitoftheview)

In another post she talked about being excited about her upcoming trip to climb the more-than 8,000 meter mountain in Pakistan.

"I'm heading out for my first big kid climbing expedition in Pakistan," she wrote. "Let's see if we can get this body and these boots up Broad Peak, the 12th highest mountain in the world."

"She was a very positive person," her father George Geis told KENS 5 local news in San Antonio. "She could do most anything she wanted to do."

News U.S. rock climber Alex Honnold reaches top of Taipei 101 skyscraper without ropes

Rescue efforts proved futile

Military helicopters and high-altitude porters and rescue teams searched the area despite challenging terrain and weather conditions, according to local police.

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra "Balen" Shah confirmed the deaths of the Nepalese climbers in a social media post on Saturday.

The remains of some of the climbers have been flown to hospitals in Pakistan, according to the Associated Press citing local police.

"Today, we mourn not only Nims, but every life lost in this tragedy," Elite Expeditions said. "Our deepest thoughts, prayers and heartfelt condolences are with their families, friends and loved ones."

title: Living With Leopards in the Himalayas - thexylom.com
description: Living With Leopards in the Himalayas  thexylom.com
publisher.title: thexylom.com
full_article:
This story was originally published by Knowable Magazine .

In the afternoon of February 22nd, 67-year-old Bulal Maharjan, a farmer living on the outskirts of Kathmandu, Nepal, was sitting on his porch chopping cauliflower leaves to feed his chickens. Hearing a loud thud as a parked motorcycle toppled, he turned and watched in horror as a leopard leapt away from the fallen vehicle and lunged at him, piercing its sharp canines into his forehead, its claws lacerating his hands.

Within seconds, neighbors swarmed in, and the leopard ran into a nearby house. They eventually trapped the animal inside. After nearly two hours of panic that saw two more people injured trying to control the distressed big cat, forest division officials managed to sedate it and bring the situation under control.

Maharjan still can’t shake off memories of the attack. “For three days straight, I couldn’t even sleep. Every time I began to doze, the scene of this attack would jolt me up!” he says. “I think we should just get rid of this animal. Period.”

Bulal Maharjan, 67, narrowly escaped a harrowing encounter with a common leopard outside his home on the outskirts of Kathmandu. (Anju Dhakal/Knowable Magazine)

Sentiments like Maharjan’s are common across Nepal, where leopards have been responsible for significant loss of human life and livestock. Research shows that in the Himalayan nation from 2000 to 2020, conflicts between humans and four large mammals — elephants, rhinos, tigers and common leopards — claimed 887 human lives and led to the killing of 1,139 animals. Of these, common leopards — Panthera pardus — were the leading cause of human deaths at an average of 19 deaths per year , and the species most frequently killed.

To try to bring the conflict under control, Nepal and other countries with human-large predator conflicts are exploring a range of solutions.

Nepal has three ecological zones: lowland dominated by Bengal tigers , mountainous regions where snow leopards roam free, and the vast mid-hill ruled by common leopards as the top predator. While protected areas in the lowlands and mountains receive dedicated conservation funding for their charismatic predators, the mid-hills are largely managed as community forests.

The celebrated community forest program is a key reason for leopards’ thriving in the mid-hills. In the early 1990s, amid worsening floods and landslides linked to forest degradation, King Birendra handed over management of large swaths of forest to local communities so that they would have stakes in conservation, and benefit from timber and fruit harvests. Today, almost 47 percent of land in Nepal is covered by forest patches. About a third of that area belongs to community forests, most of which are run by people living in the mid-hills. “But what the communities didn’t realize was they also restored habitats so that the top carnivores could return,” said Kedar Baral, a wildlife biologist for Nepal’s Bagmati province.

In 2020, Baral’s team conducted an analysis of leopard scat collected in the mid-hills that showed that 27 percent of the animals’ diet consisted of domestic animals, while the wild ungulates that big cats typically prefer to hunt, like barking deer and wild boars, made up only 10 percent. In search of sprouting leaves, barking deer venture from the dense community forests to farmland, and “as the deer enter the farmlands, that’s where the leopard follows,” says Baral, bringing them into contact with domestic livestock.

Nepal’s hydropower and construction projects are also expanding into remote forested areas at higher elevations, disturbing habitat and bringing workers as well as a new hunting pressure against top predators, including common leopards, living there. (Common leopard pelts from illegal hunting rank among the top confiscated wildlife items in Nepal.) That forces the leopards and their prey to leave their territory, says Madhu Chetri, a wildlife ecologist at the National Trust for Nature Conservation.

Climate change might be influencing conflict patterns, too. While he was working as a district forest officer in Nepal’s western mid-hills, Baral and his team were repeatedly called to respond to common leopard attacks on local communities. Over time, he noticed a change in the pattern: Conflict incidents and human or livestock deaths were increasingly reported from higher-elevation settlements.

Reporting in 2023, Baral and colleagues investigated whether climate change was driving this shift. Using data from 343 sites across Nepal based on signs of leopard scat, animal tracks and kills, he modeled habitat preferences of leopards, considering factors such as temperature, rainfall and elevation. The results suggest that leopards prefer mid-hill conditions at around 1,000 meters with moderate temperatures and high rainfall. Warming climates are likely expanding the range of suitable habitat uphill, which could allow the leopard population to grow and, as a result, have a higher risk of conflict with humans.

Of course, it is a conservation success to be celebrated when numbers of threatened or endangered large carnivores increase — whether they be lynx, wolves, tigers or leopards — but it also presents new challenges , says Philip Nyhus, a conservation biologist at Colby College in Maine. Solutions to the problem have two parts, he adds: first, to keep wildlife separate from people and their livestock to prevent conflict to begin with, and second, to mitigate impacts when conflicts do occur. “A lot of attention has been given to the second piece,” he says. “What would be better is if we could prevent conflict from happening in the first place.”

There are international examples to draw from. In the Argentinian Dry Chaco forest, for example, small households in woody areas have faced frequent attacks by pumas on sheep and goats. Sofia Nanni, a conservation biologist at the National Scientific and Technical Research Council of Argentina, worked with locals to come up with the idea of trying spiked leather collars on livestock, an approach that had proved successful in reducing leopard attacks on cows in countries like Iran.

“We found a local artisan who made collars for dogs and we asked him if he could make collars,” Nanni says. Tracking collared goats and sheep for two years, her team found that the puma predation in uncollared animal groups was 10 times higher than that in collared groups. More important, they noticed a subtle shift in public attitude, too. Since the collars were introduced, locals were less interested in retaliating against pumas even if they had an eventual attack. “I think they started to feel more empowered because they felt that something else could be done to solve the problem,” Nanni says.

In Chaco Salteño, sheep fitted with spiked collars designed by local artisans were attacked by pumas far less frequently than uncollared sheep. The initiative has also helped to soften public attitudes against pumas. (Olivia Del Giorgio/Knowable Magazine)

Nanni says a studded collar approach can work in countries such as Nepal that are leading in big carnivore conservation. But she stresses that interventions should be chosen in collaboration with the affected locals. “It’s really them who know what they can do and [who can understand] the cost effectiveness of the interventions. They also feel more attached to the project if they are part of it,” she says. Although Nepal hasn’t implemented studded collar projects, research suggests that predator-proof husbandry with improved fencing and safe corrals yield positive results.

Another important part of the solution is making relief funds widely accessible and simple to obtain: Research has shown that a quick and effective relief and compensation system can often curb human wildlife conflict, while slow, underfunded and inefficient relief programs can exacerbate conflict. Nepal’s wildlife relief guidelines offer up to a million rupees for loss of a human life, Rs. 60,000 for high-value livestock, and Rs. 10,000 for sheep and goats. Yet the payouts depend on forest officers’ assessments and are often lower. “Locals won’t pursue a relief payment of 5,000 rupees (about $33) for a predated goat if the process is cumbersome, takes months to prepare documents, and costs 3,000 rupees in the process. What’s the point of it?” says Shashank Poudel, a human-wildlife conflict specialist working with WWF Nepal.

Several other strategies are successfully reducing leopard and other top predator conflicts globally. In Kenya, researchers have used low-cost, solar-powered, multicolored LED arrays that flash to mimic human presence and keep leopards far from farms. In India, where leopards frequently raise cubs in sugarcane fields, conservationists partner with farmers to adjust harvest schedules and track the animals, thus mitigating possible conflict between humans and protective leopard mothers. Elsewhere, AI-backed camera traps help hundreds of villages anticipate tiger movement and prevent human–wildlife conflict. And research from South Africa suggests that playback of human voices as acoustic deterrents might help to discourage predators.

Still, changing attitudes and implementing effective interventions, as well as better compensation, can take years, while frustration among affected communities continues to grow. Maharjan, who survived a leopard attack, is still waiting to receive relief for his medical bills.

22 फरवरी के दुपहर मे नेपाल के काठमांडू के बाहरी इलाका में रहय वाला 67 वर्षीय बुलाल महर्जन अपन ओसारा पर बैसल फूलगोभी के पात काटि अपन मुर्गी के पेट भरैत छलाह. खड़ा मोटरसाइकिल के खसि पड़ला पर जोरदार धड़कन सुनि ओ घुमि क' भयभीत भ' क' देखैत रहल जे एकटा तेंदुआ खसल गाड़ी सं उछलि क' ओकरा पर फेफड़ा मारि क' ओकर तेज कैनाइन ओकर कपार मे छेदि क' ओकर पंजा ओकर हाथ फाटि गेलै.

सेकेंड के भीतर पड़ोसी सब झुंड में आबि गेलै आ तेंदुआ दौड़ल पास के घर में घुसि गेलै। अन्ततः ओ सभ ओहि जानवर केँ भीतर फँसा देलक। लगभग दू घंटा के घबराहट के बाद जेकरा में दू गोटे आओर घायल भ गेलाह जे व्यथित पैघ बिल्ली के काबू में राखय के कोशिश में वन प्रभाग के अधिकारी ओकरा शान्त करय में सफल रहलाह आ स्थिति पर काबू पाबि गेलाह.

महर्जन एखनो हमला’क याद नहि हिला सकैत छथि. “तीन दिन धरि लगातार नींद तक नहि आबि रहल छल, जखन-जखन नींद आबय लगैत छलहुँ, एहि हमला’क दृश्य हमरा झकझोरि दैत छल!” कहैत छथि। “हमरा लगैत अछि जे हमरा सभ केँ बस एहि जानवर सँ मुक्ति भेटबाक चाही। पीरियड।”

काठमांडू के बाहरी इलाका में अपन घर के बाहर एकटा आम तेंदुआ के संग भेल दुःखद मुठभेड़ सं 67 वर्षीय बुलाल महर्जन संकीर्ण रूप सं बचल छल. (अंजू ढकाल/ज्ञात पत्रिका)

महर्जन जैसनऽ भावना पूरा नेपाल म॑ आम छै, जहां तेंदुआ के कारण मानव जान आरू पशुधन केरऽ काफी नुकसान होय गेलऽ छै । शोध स॑ पता चलै छै कि हिमालयी राष्ट्र म॑ २००० स॑ २०२० तलक मनुष्य आरू चारो बड़ऽ स्तनधारी — हाथी, गैंडा, बाघ आरू आम तेंदुआ — के बीच संघर्ष म॑ ८८७ मनुष्य के जान गेलै आरू १,१३९ जानवरऽ के हत्या होय गेलै । एहि मे सँ आम तेंदुआ — Panthera pardus — औसतन प्रति वर्ष 19 मृत्युक संग मानव मृत्युक प्रमुख कारण छल , आ प्रजाति सबसँ बेसी मारल जाइत छल ।

द्वंद्व के नियंत्रण में लाबै के कोशिश करै लेली नेपाल आरू मानव-बड़ऽ शिकारी संघर्ष वाला अन्य देशऽ के समाधान के एक श्रृंखला के खोज करी रहलऽ छै ।

नेपालमे तीन पारिस्थितिकी क्षेत्र छै : तराई भूमि बंगाल बाघ केरऽ प्रधानता वाला , पहाड़ी क्षेत्र जहाँ हिम तेंदुआ मुक्त घूमै छै, आरू विशाल मध्य पहाड़ी जेकरा पर आम तेंदुआ केरऽ शासन शीर्ष शिकारी के रूप में होय छै । जहाँ तराई आरू पहाड़ऽ म॑ संरक्षित क्षेत्रऽ क॑ अपनऽ करिश्माई शिकारी लेली समर्पित संरक्षण फंडिंग मिलै छै, वहीं मध्य पहाड़ी केरऽ प्रबंधन काफी हद तलक सामुदायिक जंगल के रूप म॑ करलऽ जाय छै ।

प्रसिद्ध सामुदायिक वन कार्यक्रम तेंदुआ के मध्य पहाड़ी में पनपय के एकटा प्रमुख कारण छै. 1990 केरऽ दशक केरऽ शुरुआत म॑ जंगलऽ के क्षरण स॑ जुड़लऽ बिगड़तऽ बाढ़ आरू भूस्खलन के बीच राजा बीरेंद्र न॑ जंगलऽ के बड़ऽ दायरा के प्रबंधन स्थानीय समुदायऽ क॑ सौंपलकै ताकि ओकरा संरक्षण म॑ दांव मिल॑ सक॑, आरू लकड़ी आरू फल के फसल स॑ फायदा मिल॑ सक॑ । आइ नेपालक लगभग ४७ प्रतिशत जमीन वन-पैचसँ आच्छादित अछि । ओहि क्षेत्रक लगभग एक तिहाई सामुदायिक जंगलक अछि, जाहि मे अधिकांश भाग मध्य पहाड़ी मे रहनिहार लोक द्वारा चलाओल जाइत अछि । नेपाल केरऽ बागमती प्रांत केरऽ वन्यजीव जीवविज्ञानी केदार बरल न॑ कहलकै कि लेकिन समुदायऽ क॑ जे बात के अहसास नै छेलै, वू ई छेलै कि वू आवास भी बहाल करी देलकै ताकि शीर्ष मांसाहारी जानवर वापस आबी सक॑ ।

2020 म॑ बरल केरऽ टीम न॑ मध्य पहाड़ी म॑ एकत्रित तेंदुआ केरऽ स्कैट के विश्लेषण करलकै जेकरा स॑ पता चललै कि जानवरऽ के आहार म॑ 27 प्रतिशत घरेलू जानवर छेलै, जबकि जंगली उंगली वाला जानवर जेकरा बड़ऽ बिल्ली आम तौर प॑ शिकार करना पसंद करै छै, जेना कि भौंक॑ वाला हिरण आरू जंगली सुअर, ओकरऽ संख्या मात्र 10 प्रतिशत छेलै । अंकुरित पात के खोज में भौंकैत हिरण सघन सामुदायिक जंगल स’ खेती के जमीन पर उद्यम करैत अछि, आ “जहिना-जहिना हिरण खेती के जमीन में प्रवेश करैत अछि, ओतहि तेंदुआ के पाछू-पाछू चलैत अछि,” बराल कहैत अछि, ओकरा घरेलू पशुधन के संपर्क में अनैत अछि.

नेपाल केरऽ जलविद्युत आरू निर्माण परियोजना भी अधिक ऊंचाई प॑ दूरस्थ वन क्षेत्रऽ म॑ भी विस्तार करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ आवास क॑ परेशान करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै आरू मजदूरऽ के साथ-साथ आम तेंदुआ सहित शीर्ष शिकारी के खिलाफ नया शिकार के दबाव भी आबी रहलऽ छै, जे वहाँ रह॑ छै । (अवैध शिकार स॑ निकलै वाला आम तेंदुआ केरऽ चमड़ा नेपाल केरऽ शीर्ष जब्त वन्यजीव वस्तु म॑ शामिल छै ।) जेकरा स॑ तेंदुआ आरू ओकरऽ शिकार क॑ अपनऽ इलाका छोड़ै लेली मजबूर होय जाय छै, ई बात नेशनल ट्रस्ट फॉर नेचर कंजरवेशन केरऽ वन्यजीव पारिस्थितिकीविद मधु चेत्री के कहना छै ।

जलवायु परिवर्तन संघर्ष के पैटर्न के सेहो प्रभावित क रहल भ सकैत अछि. नेपाल केरऽ पश्चिमी मध्य पहाड़ी म॑ जब॑ हुनी जिला वन अधिकारी के रूप म॑ काम करी रहलऽ छेलै, त॑ बारल आरू हुनकऽ टीम क॑ बार-बार स्थानीय समुदाय प॑ तेंदुआ केरऽ आम हमला के जवाब दै लेली बोलैलऽ गेलै । समय के साथ, हुनका पैटर्न में बदलाव देखलऽ गेलै: अधिक ऊँचाई वाला बस्ती स॑ संघर्ष के घटना आरू मानव या पशुधन के मौत के खबर तेजी स॑ होय रहलऽ छेलै ।

2023 म॑ रिपोर्टिंग करतें हुअ॑ बरल आरू सहयोगी न॑ जांच करलकै कि जलवायु परिवर्तन ई बदलाव क॑ बढ़ाबै छै कि नै । तेंदुआ केरऽ स्कैट, जानवरऽ के ट्रैक आरू किल के संकेत के आधार प॑ पूरा नेपाल केरऽ ३४३ स्थलऽ के आंकड़ऽ के उपयोग करी क॑ तापमान, वर्षा आरू ऊंचाई जैसनऽ कारक प॑ विचार करी क॑ तेंदुआ केरऽ आवास पसंद के मॉडलिंग करलकै । परिणाम स॑ पता चलै छै कि तेंदुआ मध्यम तापमान आरू अधिक वर्षा के साथ लगभग १,००० मीटर के मध्य पहाड़ी परिस्थिति पसंद करै छै । संभव छै कि गर्मी बढ़ला स॑ ऊपर के तरफ उपयुक्त आवास के सीमा बढ़ी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ तेंदुआ के आबादी बढ़ी सकै छै आरू एकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप मनुष्य के साथ टकराव के खतरा अधिक होय सकै छै ।

बेशक, ई संरक्षण केरऽ सफलता छै जेकरा मनाबै के छै जब॑ खतरा म॑ पड़लऽ या विलुप्त होय रहलऽ बड़ऽ मांसाहारी जानवरऽ के संख्या बढ़ी जाय छै — चाहे वू लिंक्स, भेड़िया, बाघ या तेंदुआ होय — लेकिन ई नया चुनौती भी पेश करै छै , मेन केरऽ कोल्बी कॉलेज केरऽ संरक्षण जीवविज्ञानी फिलिप नायहस के कहना छै । समस्या के समाधान के दू भाग छै, हुनी आरू कहै छै: पहिलऽ, वन्यजीव क॑ लोगऽ आरू ओकरऽ पशुधन स॑ अलग रखना ताकि शुरू म॑ ही टकराव नै होय सक॑, आरू दोसरऽ, जब॑ टकराव जरूर होय जाय छै त॑ ओकरा प॑ पड़ै वाला प्रभाव क॑ कम करलऽ जाय । ओ कहैत छथि जे दोसर टुकड़ा पर बहुत ध्यान देल गेल अछि। “नीक की होयत जँ हम सभ पहिल बेर मे द्वंद्व नहि होबय सँ रोकि सकितहुँ।”

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय उदाहरण अछि जाहि स आकर्षित कैल जा सकैत अछि। उदाहरण लेली अर्जेंटीना केरऽ ड्राई चाको जंगल म॑ जंगली इलाका म॑ छोटऽ-छोटऽ घरऽ प॑ भेड़-बकरी प॑ प्यूमा केरऽ बार-बार हमला के सामना करना पड़लऽ छै । अर्जेंटीना केरऽ राष्ट्रीय वैज्ञानिक आरू तकनीकी अनुसंधान परिषद केरऽ संरक्षण जीवविज्ञानी सोफिया नन्नी न॑ स्थानीय लोगऽ के साथ मिल क॑ पशुधन प॑ स्पाइक वाला चमड़ा के कॉलर के कोशिश करै के विचार सामने ऐलै, जे ईरान जैसनऽ देशऽ म॑ गाय प॑ तेंदुआ के हमला क॑ कम करै म॑ सफल साबित होय गेलऽ छै ।

नन्नी कहैत छथि जे हमरा सब कए एकटा स्थानीय कारीगर भेटल जे कुकुर लेल कॉलर बनबैत छल आ हम हुनका स पूछलहुं जे की ओ कॉलर बना सकैत छी। दू साल तक कॉलर वाला बकरी आरू भेड़ऽ के ट्रैकिंग करतें हुअ॑ हुनकऽ टीम न॑ पालै छै कि बिना कॉलर वाला जानवरऽ के समूह म॑ प्यूमा के शिकार कॉलर वाला समूहऽ के तुलना म॑ १० गुना अधिक छै । एहि स बेसी महत्वपूर्ण बात इ जे हुनका सब कए सार्वजनिक दृष्टिकोण मे सेहो सूक्ष्म बदलाव देखल गेल। जहिया स कॉलर शुरू भेल छल, स्थानीय लोक कए अंततः हमला भ गेलाक बादो प्यूमा क प्रतिकार करबा मे कम रुचि छल। नन्नी कहैत छथि, “हमरा लगैत अछि जे हुनका सब कए बेसी सशक्त महसूस होबय लागल, किया कि हुनका सब कए लागल जे एहि समस्या क समाधान लेल किछु आओर कैल जा सकैत अछि।

चाको सालटेनो में स्थानीय कारीगर द्वारा डिजाइन कयल गेल स्पाइक कॉलर सं फिट भेड़ पर बिना कॉलर वाला भेड़ सं कहीं कम प्यूमा हमला करैत छल. एहि पहल स प्यूमा क खिलाफ जनता क रवैया कए नरम करबा मे सेहो मदद भेटल अछि। (ओलिविया डेल जॉर्जियो/ज्ञात पत्रिका)

नन्नी के कहनाय छनि जे स्टडेड कॉलर एप्रोच नेपाल सन देश मे काज क सकैत अछि जे पैघ मांसाहारी संरक्षण मे अग्रणी अछि. लेकिन हुनी ई बात प॑ जोर दै छै कि प्रभावित स्थानीय लोगऽ के सहयोग स॑ हस्तक्षेप के चयन करलऽ जाय । ओ कहैत छथि, "वास्तव मे इ हुनका सब कए पता अछि जे ओ की क सकैत छथि आ [के बुझि सकैत छथि] हस्तक्षेप क लागत प्रभावशीलता कए। ओ एहि परियोजना स बेसी लगाव सेहो महसूस करैत छथि अगर ओ एकर हिस्सा छथि।" भले ही नेपाल स्टड कॉलर परियोजना लागू नै करलकै, लेकिन शोध स॑ पता चलै छै कि बेहतर बाड़ आरू सुरक्षित कोरल के साथ शिकारी-प्रूफ खेती के सकारात्मक परिणाम मिलै छै ।

समाधान कें एकटा आ महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा राहत धनराशि कें व्यापक रूप सं सुलभ आ प्राप्त करय मे सरल बनानाय छै: शोध सं पता चलल छै कि एकटा त्वरित आ प्रभावी राहत आ मुआवजा प्रणाली अक्सर मानव वन्यजीव संघर्ष पर लगाम लगा सकय छै, जखन कि धीमा, कम वित्त पोषित आ अकुशल राहत कार्यक्रम संघर्ष कें बढ़ा सकय छै. नेपाल के वन्यजीव राहत दिशानिर्देश में एक लाख रुपया तक के एक मानव जान के नुकसान, 100 रुपया के प्रस्ताव देल गेल अछि। उच्च मूल्यक पशुधन लेल 60,000, आ 100,000 रुपैया। 10 हजार भेड़-बकरी लेल। तइयो भुगतान वन अधिकारीक आकलन पर निर्भर करैत अछि आ प्रायः कम होइत अछि. “स्थानीय लोक एकटा शिकारी बकरी लेल 5000 रुपैया (करीब 33 डॉलर) के राहत भुगतान के पीछा नहि करत जँ ई प्रक्रिया बोझिल होयत, दस्तावेज तैयार करबा मे महीना भरि लागत, आ एहि प्रक्रिया मे 3000 रुपैया खर्च होयत. एकर की फायदा?” डब्लूडब्लूएफ नेपाल के साथ कार्यरत मानव-वन्यजीव संघर्ष विशेषज्ञ शशांक पौडेल कहै छै ।

कई अन्य रणनीति वैश्विक स्तर पर तेंदुआ आरू अन्य शीर्ष शिकारी संघर्ष क॑ सफलतापूर्वक कम करी रहलऽ छै । केन्या म॑ शोधकर्ता न॑ कम लागत वाला, सौर ऊर्जा स॑ चलै वाला, बहुरंगी एलईडी सरणी के इस्तेमाल करल॑ छै जे मानव उपस्थिति के नकल करै लेली चमकै छै आरू तेंदुआ क॑ खेतऽ स॑ दूर रखै छै । भारत मे, जतय तेंदुआ अक्सर गन्ना कें खेत मे बच्चाक कें पालन-पोषण करएयत छै, संरक्षणकर्मी किसानक कें साथ भागीदारी कयर कटाई कें कार्यक्रम कें समायोजन आ जानवरक कें ट्रैक करएयत छै, जेकरा सं मनुष्य आ सुरक्षात्मक तेंदुआ कें मां कें बीच संभावित टकराव कम भ जायत छै. अन्य जगहऽ प॑ एआई समर्थित कैमरा ट्रैप सैकड़ों गाँवऽ क॑ बाघऽ के आवाजाही के पूर्वानुमान लगाबै म॑ मदद करै छै आरू मानव-वन्यजीव संघर्ष क॑ रोकै म॑ मदद करै छै । आरू दक्षिण अफ्रीका केरऽ शोध स॑ पता चलै छै कि ध्वनिक निवारक के रूप म॑ मानव आवाज के प्लेबैक शिकारी जानवरऽ क॑ हतोत्साहित करै म॑ मदद करी सकै छै ।

तइयो, दृष्टिकोण बदलनाय आ प्रभावी हस्तक्षेपक कें लागू करय कें संग-संग बेहतर मुआवजा कें लेल सालक कें समय लग सकएय छै, जखन कि प्रभावित समुदायक कें बीच कुंठा बढ़नाय जारी छै. तेंदुआ केरऽ हमला स॑ बची गेलऽ महर्जन क॑ अखनी तलक मेडिकल बिल म॑ राहत मिलै के इंतजार छै ।

publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Lalitpur, Aug. 2: Deepmala Dhakal was crowned Miss Nepal World 2026 amid a grand finale held in Pulchowk, Lalitpur on Saturday.

At the same event, Kashis Subba won the title of Miss Nepal Cosmo 2026, while Arya Nishaant was crowned Miss Nepal International 2026.

Dhakal emerged victorious after outperforming 23 finalists in one of Nepal’s most prestigious

beauty pageants, organised by The Hidden Treasure. She will now represent Nepal at the Miss World international pageant.

Prior to winning the national title, Dhakal had earned recognition as Miss Nepal Hong Kong International 2026.

Born and raised in Hong Kong, she is a graduate of the University of Hong Kong and has worked as an investment strategist.

Following her coronation, Miss Nepal Dhakal expressed gratitude to the organisers, judges, supporters, and her family, saying the crown carries a great responsibility.

Twenty-four-year-old Deepmala said her mother has been her biggest inspiration. Her mother had taken part in the first Miss Nepal pageant in 1994.

Deepmala works as an investment strategist at BlackRock. She is also a taekwondo black belt holder, a marathon runner, and holds a Bachelor’s degree in economics.

राष्ट्रीय खिताब जीतय सं पहिने ढकल मिस नेपाल हांगकांग इन्टरनेशनल २०२६ के रूप मे मान्यता अर्जित केने छल ।

राज्याभिषेक के बाद मिस नेपाल ढकाल न॑ आयोजक, निर्णायक, समर्थक, आरू अपनऽ परिवार के प्रति आभार व्यक्त करतें हुअ॑ कहलकै कि ताज केरऽ बहुत बड़ऽ जिम्मेदारी छै ।

title: Opinion | The persistent cycle of hope, expectation and dismay in modern Nepal - The Kathmandu Post
description: Opinion | The persistent cycle of hope, expectation and dismay in modern Nepal  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Some notable features of modern Nepali history include the praxis of transition as well as people’s expectations, hopes and frustrations. This is indeed a feature of transition in the world. But in Nepal, as history shows, stories of dismay and unfulfilled expectations are mixed with dreams of change. We can see this pattern if we consider the major transitions that have occurred in the latter decades of the 20th century and the first two decades of the 21st century.

The transitions are notable for a few reasons. Political scientists, politicians (except a few) and social scientists have studied this subject. Many seminars and research projects are conducted, and academic theses are written on this phenomenon of transition in Nepal. It is beyond the scope of a short take and the subjective perception of a literary academic even to outline them. I want to share my personal impressions about the praxis of transition and the pattern of adjustment that recurs at intervals in modern Nepal. People of past generations saw and even experienced a number of praxes, and the younger generations have experienced a few of them. They have created some, we can say, as in the latest example of the Gen Z uprising.

The focus of every transition, interestingly and remarkably, is the people and the question of their rights. Every transition has projected people’s rights and bears testimony to their violations. An important instance has occurred in modern Nepali political and social history. This is surprisingly overlooked by both political parties and historians. I want to begin with a remarkable court hearing that is historical in a number of ways: BP Koirala’s court testimony in 1977. Following King Mahendra’s coup and the dissolution of Parliament in December 1960, Koirala and his colleagues, including Ganesh Man Singh, were put in Sundarijal prison. After his release in 1968, BP chose to go to India with his colleagues. He spent several years there before returning to Nepal in 1976 for some reportedly compelling reasons. Arrested again, BP was tried at a makeshift court.

It is important to revisit one important aspect of that testimony in today’s Nepal, when the question of people’s dignity in this country has become a motif of discussion. The testimony that BP gave in court is a very important political document that evokes the system of justice and democracy. There, BP questioned the legality of his arrest and the audacity of the king to strip the people of their democratic rights by dissolving the Parliament they had elected. A great theatrical or dramatic quality was in that court testimony, something that those working in theatre, including me, thought should be staged.

It was difficult to find this important document even among Nepali Congress people, which dismayed me then. A professor of political science, Krishna Khanal, gave me a photocopy of the document, based on which I wrote a play titled Sandajuko Mahabharat that was staged at Village Theatre under the direction of an NSD Delhi theatre graduate, Bimal Subedi. It was an entirely non-partisan theatrical exercise. Academic Sanjeev Uprety brilliantly played the role of BP alias Sandaju, and theatre artist Suryamala Sharma played the role of Sushila Koirala. Other young generation theatre artists successfully played the rest of the roles. We could not perform the play even for a month because of the Indian ‘embargo’ imposed under the order of Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi. That made it impossible for the audience to find public transport to come to see the play.

The highlight of the court hearing of BP is the written testimony he gave in court. Referring to the royal coup, BP said in front of the jury—the day the king staged the coup in December 1960, millions of Nepalis felt that they had lost their prestige; they felt demoralised. And that was a serious blow to the human rights and dignity of the people. I do not want to cite other arguments that BP Koirala presented at the court in his own defence as an individual defendant and a lawyer. That was the first time when a lawyer, a freedom fighter, had pleaded at the court on behalf of the entire people of Nepal. The question of prestige and the phenomenon of demoralisation deserve special mention today when Nepali people are fighting for the same.

That court hearing and the question of the dignity of people is the mantra of Nepali popular historical uprisings. But there is a pattern of people’s frustration that appears after every political transition in this country. The time of transition naturally brings euphoria, which does not last in that shape for very long. History shows that some patterns of people’s frustrations have some common roots. For a widely cited example, the system gets mired in practices commonly called corruption, indifference and injustice. After every shaking political change, people naturally wait for their government to come up with good plans and visions of amelioration.

But the experience shows that even realistic expectations of people are not addressed. Maitighar Mandala becomes agog with demonstrations of many groups who travel long distances to become visible and put their grievances to successive governments. That principally includes corruption, the settlement question, betrayal by moneylenders, educational conundrums and, most important of all, a sense of losing prestige or dignity. This may remind us of absurd plays staged by actors who are not heard and, painfully, they know that.

Many historical events have occurred in Nepal in the 21st century. One important element of these praxes is the transition to democratic rule. The present multiparty republican constitution, which may require necessary reviews and amendments in the course of time, represents a solid example of the spirit of transition. The diverse approaches to political change meet at a common platform. The Parliament is such a forum where the erstwhile Maoist guerrillas, the Nepali Congress, the various factions of the communists of Nepal, the advocates of the abolished monarchical system, and, more recently, the Rastriya Swatantra Party, which won a majority in the general election and includes Gen Zers, all meet and discuss, though this does not appear to be happening as expected. Judging by the praxis of change, we can say that democratic history has not ended in Nepal.

आधुनिक नेपाली इतिहास केरऽ कुछ उल्लेखनीय विशेषता म॑ संक्रमण केरऽ प्रैक्सी के साथ-साथ लोगऽ के अपेक्षा, आशा आरू कुंठा भी शामिल छै । ई सचमुच दुनिया में संक्रमण के एकटा विशेषता छै। मुदा नेपाल मे जेना इतिहास देखा रहल अछि, निराशा आ अपूर्ण अपेक्षाक कथा परिवर्तनक सपना मे मिश्रित अछि । 20वीं सदी के अंतिम दशक आ 21वीं सदी के पहिल दू दशक में जे प्रमुख संक्रमण भेल अछि ओकरा पर विचार करी त ई पैटर्न देख सकैत छी ।

संक्रमण किछु कारण स उल्लेखनीय अछि। राजनीति वैज्ञानिक, राजनीतिज्ञ (किछु छोड़ि) आ सामाजिक वैज्ञानिक एहि विषयक अध्ययन केने छथि । नेपाल मे संक्रमणक एहि घटना पर बहुत रास गोष्ठी आ शोध परियोजना संचालित होइत अछि, आ शैक्षणिक शोध प्रबंध लिखल जाइत अछि । छोट-छोट टेक आ साहित्यिक शिक्षाविदक व्यक्तिपरक धारणा सॅं सेहो बाहर अछि जे एकर रूपरेखा तैयार करब । संक्रमण के प्रैक्सी आ आधुनिक नेपाल में अंतराल पर दोहराबय वाला समायोजन के पैटर्न के बारे में हम अपन व्यक्तिगत छाप साझा करय चाहैत छी. पिछला पीढ़ी के लोक कतेको प्रैक्स देखलक आ अनुभव तक केलक, आ नव पीढ़ी के सेहो किछु एहन अनुभव भेल अछि. ओ सब किछु के सृजन केने छथि, हम कहि सकैत छी, जेना जेन जेड विद्रोह के नवीनतम उदाहरण में अछि.

हर संक्रमण केरऽ केंद्र बिंदु, रोचक आरू उल्लेखनीय रूप स॑, जनता आरू ओकरऽ अधिकारऽ के सवाल छै । हर संक्रमण लोक के अधिकार के प्रोजेक्ट केलक अछि आओर ओकर उल्लंघन के गवाही दैत अछि. आधुनिक नेपाली राजनीतिक आ सामाजिक इतिहास मे एकटा महत्वपूर्ण घटना घटल अछि । एकरा राजनीतिक दल आ इतिहासकार दुनू आश्चर्यजनक रूप स अनदेखी करैत छथि । हम एकटा उल्लेखनीय अदालती सुनवाई स शुरू करय चाहैत छी जे कई तरह स ऐतिहासिक अछि : 1977 मे बी.पी. 1968 मे रिहाई क बाद बीपी अपन सहयोगी क संग भारत जेबाक फैसला केलथि। ओतहि कतेको वर्ष बितेलनि, तकर बाद 1976 मे किछु कथित मजबूर करयवला कारण सँ नेपाल वापस आबि गेलाह । फेर गिरफ्तार भेल बीपी पर अस्थायी अदालत मे मुकदमा चलल।

आजुक नेपाल मे ओहि गवाहीक एकटा महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष पर पुनर्विचार करब जरूरी अछि, जखन कि एहि देश मे लोकक गरिमाक प्रश्न चर्चाक मोटिफ बनि गेल अछि । बीपी न॑ कोर्ट म॑ जे गवाही देलकै, वू एगो बहुत महत्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक दस्तावेज छेकै जे न्याय आरू लोकतंत्र केरऽ व्यवस्था क॑ उकसाबै छै । ओतय बीपी हुनकर गिरफ्तारी के वैधता आ राजा के दुस्साहस पर सवाल उठेलनि जे ओ जनता के लोकतांत्रिक अधिकार छीन क अपन चुनल संसद के भंग क देलखिन्ह. ओहि कोर्टक गवाही मे एकटा पैघ रंगमंच वा नाटकीय गुण छल , जे हमरा सहित रंगमंच मे काज करय बला लोकनि सोचने छलाह जे मंचन हेबाक चाही ।

नेपाली कांग्रेसक लोक मे सेहो ई महत्वपूर्ण दस्तावेज भेटब कठिन छल, जे तखन हमरा निराश क देलक। राजनीति विज्ञान के एकटा प्रोफेसर कृष्ण खनाल हमरा ओहि दस्तावेज के फोटोकॉपी देलखिन्ह, जकर आधार पर हम संदाजुको महाभारत नामक नाटक लिखलहुं जे एनएसडी दिल्ली के रंगमंच सं स्नातक बिमल सुबेदी के निर्देशन में गाम रंगमंच में मंचित भेल छल. ई पूर्णतः गैर-दलीय नाट्य अभ्यास छल । अकादमिक संजीव उप्रेती शानदार ढंग स बीपी उर्फ ​​संदाजू क भूमिका निभेलथि, आ रंगकर्मी सूर्यमाला शर्मा सुशीला कोइराला क भूमिका निभेलथि । बाकी भूमिका मे अन्य युवा पीढ़ीक रंगकर्मी सफलतापूर्वक निभौलनि । प्रधानमंत्री राजीव गांधी के आदेश पर लगाओल गेल भारतीय ‘नाकाबंदी’ के कारण हम एक महीना तक नाटक के प्रदर्शन नहि क सकलहुं. जाहि स दर्शक कए नाटक देखबा लेल आबय लेल सार्वजनिक परिवहन भेटब असंभव भ गेल।

बीपी के कोर्ट सुनवाई के खास बात कोर्ट मे हुनकर लिखित गवाही अछि. शाही तख्तापलटक जिक्र करैत बी.पी., निर्णायक मंडलक सोझां कहलनि-जहिना दिसम्बर 1960 में राजा तख्तापलट केने छलाह, लाखों नेपाली कें लागलनि जे अपन प्रतिष्ठा गमा लेने छथि ; हुनका लोकनिक मनोबल गिरल बुझाइत छलनि। आ से जनताक मानव अधिकार आ स्वाभिमान पर गंभीर प्रहार छल । हम अन्य तर्क नहि देबय चाहैत छी जे बी.पी.कोइराला अपन बचाव मे व्यक्तिगत प्रतिवादी आ वकील के रूप मे कोर्ट मे पेश केने छलाह. ओ पहिल बेर छल जखन कोनो वकील, स्वतंत्रता सेनानी, समस्त नेपाल जनताक दिस सँ कोर्ट मे गुहार लगेने छलाह । प्रतिष्ठा के प्रश्न आ मनोबल गिरै के घटना आइ विशेष उल्लेख के पात्र अछि जखन नेपाली जनता ओही लेल लड़ि रहल अछि ।

ओ कोर्ट सुनवाई आ लोकक मर्यादाक प्रश्न नेपाली लोक ऐतिहासिक विद्रोहक मंत्र थिक । मुदा लोक के कुंठा के एकटा पैटर्न अछि जे एहि देश मे हर राजनीतिक संक्रमण के बाद देखाइत अछि. संक्रमण के समय स्वाभाविक रूप स उल्लास लाबैत अछि, जे ओहि आकार मे बहुत दिन तक नहि चलैत अछि । इतिहास बताबैत अछि जे लोकक कुंठाक किछु पैटर्नक किछु समान जड़ि होइत छैक | एकरऽ व्यापक रूप स॑ उद्धृत उदाहरण लेली ई व्यवस्था ऐन्हऽ प्रथा म॑ डूबी जाय छै जेकरा आमतौर प॑ भ्रष्टाचार, उदासीनता आरू अन्याय कहलऽ जाय छै । हर हिलैत राजनीतिक परिवर्तन के बाद लोक स्वाभाविक रूप सं इंतजार करैत छथिन्ह जे हुनकर सरकार नीक योजना आओर सुधार के विजन बनाबय.

लेकिन अनुभव स॑ पता चलै छै कि लोगऽ के यथार्थवादी अपेक्षा भी पूरा नै होय छै । मैतीघर मंडला कतेको समूह के प्रदर्शन स त्रस्त भ जाइत अछि जे देखबा मे आबय लेल लंबा दूरी तय करैत अछि आ अपन शिकायत के लगातार सरकार के सामने राखैत अछि. जेकरा म॑ मुख्य रूप स॑ भ्रष्टाचार, निपटारा के सवाल, साहूकारऽ द्वारा विश्वासघात, शैक्षिक उलझन आरू सब स॑ महत्वपूर्ण बात ई छै कि प्रतिष्ठा या गरिमा खोबै के भाव शामिल छै । एहि सँ हमरा लोकनि केँ एहन अभिनेता द्वारा मंचित बेतुका नाटक मोन पड़ि सकैत अछि जे नहि सुनल जाइत छथि आ कष्टदायक बात ई जे हुनका लोकनि केँ ई बात बुझल छनि ।

२१म शताब्दीमे नेपालमे अनेक ऐतिहासिक घटना घटल अछि । ई प्रैक्सऽ के एगो महत्वपूर्ण तत्व छै लोकतांत्रिक शासन के तरफ संक्रमण । वर्तमान बहुदलीय गणतंत्रीय संविधान, जेकरा समय के साथ आवश्यक समीक्षा आरू संशोधन के आवश्यकता पड़॑ सकै छै, संक्रमण के भावना के एगो ठोस उदाहरण के प्रतिनिधित्व करै छै । राजनीतिक परिवर्तन के विविध दृष्टिकोण एकटा साझा मंच पर मिलैत अछि । संसद एहन मंच अछि जतय पूर्ववर्ती माओवादी गुरिल्ला, नेपाली कांग्रेस, नेपालक कम्युनिस्टक विभिन्न गुट, उन्मूलित राजतंत्रीय व्यवस्थाक पक्षधर, आ, हालहि मे, राष्ट्रिय स्वतंत्र पार्टी, जे आम चुनाव मे बहुमत जीतने आ जेनरल जेर केँ सेहो शामिल करैत अछि, सब मिलिकय चर्चा करैत अछि, यद्यपि ई अपेक्षित रूप सँ नहि भ' रहल बुझाइत अछि । परिवर्तन के प्रैक्सी स अंदाजा लगा सकैत छी जे लोकतांत्रिक इतिहास नेपाल मे समाप्त नहि भेल अछि ।

title: Nepali political solidarity visible in times of crisis - The Kathmandu Post
description: Nepali political solidarity visible in times of crisis  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
When communal tensions erupted in Sunsari’s Dewanganj and threatened to spread to neighbouring districts, it was not only the government and security agencies that moved to contain the situation.

Political parties in government and the opposition and those outside Parliament also stepped in.

Parties that routinely attack the government closed ranks, reinforcing a familiar pattern in Nepali politics: when the country faces a major crisis, political rivals often put aside their differences and act together.

The ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP), Parliament’s strongest and youngest political force, followed a path long taken by Nepal’s legacy parties. Recognising that communal unrest required a coordinated political response, RSP chair Rabi Lamichhane convened an all-party meeting with urgency.

The initiative drew support across party lines. Leaders attending the emergency meeting included Gagan Thapa, president of the main opposition Nepali Congress; Pushpa Kamal Dahal, coordinator of the Nepali Communist Party; Shankar Pokhrel, general secretary of the CPN-UML; Mahantha Thakur, chairman of the Loktantrik Samajbadi Party; Aren Rai, general secretary of the Shram Sanskriti Party; Rajendra Lingden, chairman of the Rastriya Prajatantra Party; CK Raut, chairman of the Janamat Party; and Prakash Adhikari, leader of the Janata Samajbadi Party Nepal. The participation of the opposition leaders at a meeting called by the ruling party was widely viewed as a positive sign.

The meeting put out a joint statement in which leaders appealed for social harmony, peace and dialogue. They also urged party organisations at the provincial, district and local levels to organise all-party and multi-stakeholder meetings to help ease tensions on the ground.

Following the Wednesday meeting, political parties instructed their organisational units to engage in community outreach and mediation efforts. Opposition leader Thapa took a particularly active role in mobilising the Congress network.

The combined efforts of political leaders, security agencies, religious figures and civil society groups helped restore calm across the affected districts.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah initially faced criticism over what many viewed as a slow response to the unrest in Madhesh. Critics accused him of remaining confined to Singha Durbar, failing to respond publicly to the deteriorating situation and not engaging directly with stakeholders in the affected region.

As criticism intensified, Shah became more active.

He addressed the nation, calling for religious and social harmony, visited Sheetal Niwas to meet President Ramchandra Paudel in his first formal meeting with the head of state since taking office, and held consultations with Madhesh-based political leaders as well as lawmakers from his own party representing the region.

Those meetings helped address concerns over the government’s position on the crisis. Shah reiterated his commitment to the federal democratic republic and sought to dispel misconceptions about his government’s approach to key national issues.

Political analysts say that while security measures were crucial in containing violence, the visible cooperation among political parties was equally important in stopping the crisis from escalating further.

“Political competition, changes in government, parliamentary obstruction, street protests and political mudslinging are all part of everyday politics. But coming together during a national crisis is a distinctive feature of Nepal’s political culture,” said Nilamber Acharya, a former diplomat and politician.

“There is an established culture in Nepali politics of respecting and making space even for those against whom parties have fought elections or organised street protests.”

Acharya said the tradition dates back to the 1950 revolution.

“Our political culture is based on tolerance, dialogue, interaction and cooperation. Compared with other countries in South Asia, Nepal has developed a healthy tradition of consultation between the government and the opposition and of building multi-party consensus,” he said.

He also praised Lamichhane for continuing that tradition despite leading a relatively new political force.

“It is encouraging that new political forces are carrying forward long-established political practices,” Acharya said. “The ruling party took the initiative to convene the meeting, which was the right step, and opposition parties set aside their differences to attend, which is equally commendable.”

At the same time, Acharya said such initiatives should ideally be led by the prime minister.

“Although there was some delay, the prime minister has gradually become more engaged. That is a positive development, but it needs to continue,” he said.

A long tradition of crisis consensus

The political unity displayed during the communal strife in Sunsari is only the latest example of a recurring pattern in Nepal’s modern political history. At key turning points, including the 12-point Delhi understanding of 2005, the subsequent peace process, constitution writing, the 2015 earthquake, the border dispute with India in 2019, the Covid-19 pandemic and successive constitutional crises, political parties have consistently set aside partisan interests to protect national stability and social cohesion.

After King Gyanendra Shah assumed direct rule on February 1, 2005, a seven-party alliance comprising the Nepali Congress, the CPN-UML, the Nepali Congress (Democratic), Janamorcha Nepal, the Nepal Majdoor Kisan Party, Nepal Sadbhawana Party (Anandi Devi) and the United Left Front joined hands with the CPN (Maoist), which at the time was waging an armed insurgency.

The alliance was widely regarded as improbable. While the seven parties were operating within the constitutional political system, the Maoists were fighting a decade-long armed conflict. Few believed the parliamentary parties and the rebels could find common ground.

The 12-point understanding overturned that assumption.

United by the shared objective of restoring democracy and ending the King’s direct rule, the seven-party alliance and the Maoists forged a common political platform. The agreement laid the foundation for the 2006 People’s Movement, which forced the monarchy to relinquish power, restored the dissolved House of Representatives and paved the way for the Comprehensive Peace Accord, formally ending the decade-long conflict.

The consensus also brought the Maoists into mainstream politics and ultimately led Nepal’s transition to a federal democratic republic.

The culture of political cooperation during national crises, however, predates the peace process.

During the 1989 movement against the Panchayat regime, the Nepali Congress and the United Left Front joined forces despite profound ideological differences. Their joint movement restored multi-party democracy, resulting in an interim government representing both sides, the promulgation of the 1990 Constitution and parliamentary elections in 1991.

Although the Congress and communist parties became fierce electoral rivals in the years that followed, the democratic system accommodated former Panchayat leaders who had previously opposed the pro-democracy movement, reflecting a broader political culture of inclusion rather than exclusion.

The same spirit resurfaced during the constitution-writing process.

When the first Constituent Assembly convened in 2008, political parties unanimously voted to abolish the monarchy on May 28 that year. The consensus, however, soon gave way to bitter disputes over federal boundaries, the system of governance, electoral arrangements, judicial structure and state restructuring.

Despite extending the Constituent Assembly’s term several times, political parties failed to bridge their differences. The assembly was dissolved on May 27, 2012 without delivering a constitution, triggering a deep constitutional crisis.

With no agreement on who should head the government or oversee fresh elections, the parties eventually reached an unprecedented compromise by appointing sitting Chief Justice Khil Raj Regmi to lead an interim cabinet.

The arrangement drew criticism because it blurred the separation between the executive and the judiciary. Even so, political parties accepted the proposal as an exceptional measure to preserve the constitutional process. The agreement enabled elections to the second Constituent Assembly in 2013.

Political consensus again became crucial after the devastating earthquake of April 25, 2015.

Even as parties remained divided over the contents of the new constitution, they worked together on rescue, relief and reconstruction efforts. Seeking to restore political stability, the Nepali Congress, the CPN-UML, the UCPN (Maoist) and the Madhesi Janadhikar Forum (Loktantrik) signed a historic 16-point agreement on June 8, 2015, breaking years of political deadlock and clearing the way for the promulgation of the Constitution of Nepal on September 20 that year.

Subsequent crises prompted similar cooperation.

Political parties presented a united front during the nearly six-month border blockade later in 2015. They jointly endorsed the first constitutional amendment on January 23, 2016 to address concerns raised in Madhesh and later worked together to hold local, provincial and federal elections in 2017 under the new constitutional framework.

Another striking example came on June 13, 2020, when the House of Representatives unanimously approved a constitutional amendment updating Nepal’s map to include Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura. The amendment was endorsed by all 258 lawmakers present, with no votes against.

More recently, major political parties closed ranks against campaigns advocating the restoration of monarchy, demonstrations organised by the Durga Prasai-led group and the renewed political activities of deposed king Gyanendra, maintaining that safeguarding the federal democratic republic transcended partisan competition.

Even after the Gen Z uprising of September 8 and 9, 2025, which led to the collapse of the UML-Congress coalition, attacks on the party headquarters and the homes of senior leaders, and the formation of an interim government led by former chief justice Sushila Karki, political parties ultimately prioritised constitutional continuity.

Although several parties initially questioned the constitutionality of the interim arrangement, they later joined consultations convened by prime minister Karki and the Election Commission before participating in the March 5 general elections, helping return the country to constitutional rule.

Political analyst Bhaskar Gautam said Nepal’s political culture has increasingly relied on dialogue to overcome major structural crises, particularly since the end of the armed conflict.

“Following last year’s youth uprising, there was deep mistrust and anxiety among traditional political parties and leaders,” Gautam said. “Yet despite those reservations, everyone ultimately accepted elections as the way forward. Because all stakeholders took ownership of the process, the transition succeeded.”

He said Nepal’s experience contrasts with that of many other countries.

“In many countries, crises deepen political divisions. In Nepal, they often create opportunities for dialogue and consensus,” Gautam said. “No government can resolve complex socio-political challenges alone by treating its opponents as enemies. Institutionalising this culture of dialogue and collective action will remain essential for the country’s long-term stability.”

सुनसरी केरऽ देवांगंज म॑ जब॑ सांप्रदायिक तनाव पैदा होय गेलै आरू पड़ोसी जिला म॑ भी फैलला के खतरा पैदा होय गेलै त॑ खाली सरकार आरू सुरक्षा एजेंसी ही नै छेलै कि ई स्थिति प॑ काबू पाबै लेली आगू बढ़लै ।

सरकार मे राजनीतिक दल आओर विपक्ष आओर संसद सं बाहर के लोक सेहो एहि मे कदम रखलखिन्ह.

नियमित रूप स सरकार पर हमला करय वाला दल सब कतार बंद क देलक, जे नेपाली राजनीति मे एकटा परिचित पैटर्न कए मजबूत केलक: जखन देश कए कोनो पैघ संकट क सामना करय पड़ैत अछि त राजनीतिक प्रतिद्वंदी अक्सर अपन मतभेद कए एक कात राखि कए एक संग काज करैत अछि ।

संसद केरऽ सबस॑ मजबूत आरू सबसें कम उम्र के राजनीतिक शक्ति सत्तारूढ़ राष्ट्रिय स्वतंत्र पार्टी (आरएसपी) नेपाल केरऽ विरासत दलऽ द्वारा बहुत दिन स॑ चलै वाला रास्ता प॑ चलै छेलै । साम्प्रदायिक अशांति के समन्वित राजनीतिक प्रतिक्रिया के आवश्यकता के स्वीकार करैत आरएसपी के अध्यक्ष रबी लामिछाने तात्कालिकता के संग सर्वदलीय बैसार बजौलखिन्ह.

एहि पहल कए पार्टी लाइन क पार समर्थन भेटल। आपातकालीन बैसारमे उपस्थित नेतासभमे मुख्य विपक्षी दल नेपाली कांग्रेसके अध्यक्ष गगन थापा; नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट पार्टीके संयोजक पुष्पकमल दाहाल डा. नेकपा एमाले के महासचिव शंकर पोखरेल, प्रो. लोकतान्त्रिक समाजबादी पार्टी के अध्यक्ष महन्था ठाकुर, प्रो. श्रम संस्कृति पार्टी के महासचिव अरेन राय, प्रो. राष्ट्रीय प्रजातंत्र पार्टी के अध्यक्ष राजेन्द्र लिंगडेन, प्रो. जनमत पार्टी के अध्यक्ष सीके राउत, प्रो. आ जनता समाजबादी पार्टी नेपालक नेता प्रकाश अधिकारी। सत्ताधारी दल द्वारा बजाओल गेल बैसार मे विपक्षी नेता सभक सहभागिता केँ व्यापक रूप सँ सकारात्मक संकेतक रूप मे देखल गेल।

बैसार मे संयुक्त बयान देल गेल जाहि मे नेता सब सामाजिक सौहार्द, शांति आ संवाद के अपील केलथि। संगहि प्रांतीय, जिला आ स्थानीय स्तर पर पार्टी संगठन स आग्रह केलथि जे जमीन पर तनाव कम करबा मे मदद करबा लेल सर्वदलीय आ बहु-हितधारक बैसार क आयोजन कैल जाए।

बुधदिन केरऽ बैठक के बाद राजनीतिक दल न॑ अपनऽ संगठनात्मक इकाई क॑ सामुदायिक आउटरीच आरू मध्यस्थता के प्रयास म॑ शामिल होय के निर्देश देलकै । कांग्रेस संजाल जुटाबय मे विपक्षी नेता थापा विशेष सक्रिय भूमिका निभेलनि ।

राजनीतिक नेता, सुरक्षा एजेंसी, धार्मिक हस्ती आरू नागरिक समाज के समूह के संयुक्त प्रयास स॑ पूरा प्रभावित जिला म॑ शांति बहाल करै म॑ मदद मिललै ।

प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह क॑ शुरू म॑ आलोचना के सामना करना पड़लै, जेकरा बहुत लोगऽ न॑ मधेश केरऽ अशांति केरऽ धीमा प्रतिक्रिया के रूप म॑ देखलकै । आलोचकऽ न॑ हुनका प॑ आरोप लगैलकै कि हुनी सिंघा दरबार म॑ ही सीमित रहलऽ छै, बिगड़तऽ स्थिति के सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ जवाब नै दै छै आरू प्रभावित क्षेत्र केरऽ हितधारकऽ स॑ सीधा संपर्क नै करलकै ।

आलोचना जेना-जेना तेज होइत गेल, शाह सक्रिय होइत गेलाह।

ओ राष्ट्र के संबोधित करैत धार्मिक आ सामाजिक सौहार्द के आह्वान केलनि, पदभार ग्रहण के बाद राष्ट्रपति रामचंद्र पौडेल सं पहिल औपचारिक बैसार मे राष्ट्रपति रामचंद्र पौडेल सं भेंट करय लेल शीतल निवास के दौरा केलनि, आ मधेश के राजनीतिक नेता के संग संग क्षेत्र के प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला अपनहि पार्टी के विधायक सं सेहो परामर्श केलनि.

ओहि बैसार सभ सं संकट पर सरकार के रुख पर चिंता के दूर करय मे मदद मिलल. शाह न॑ संघीय लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य के प्रति अपनऽ प्रतिबद्धता क॑ दोहरैलकै आरू प्रमुख राष्ट्रीय मुद्दा प॑ अपनऽ सरकार केरऽ दृष्टिकोण के बारे म॑ गलत धारणा क॑ दूर करै के कोशिश करलकै ।

राजनीतिक विश्लेषकऽ के कहना छै कि हिंसा क॑ रोकै म॑ सुरक्षा उपाय जहाँ बहुत महत्वपूर्ण छेलै, वहीं संकट क॑ आरू बढ़ै स॑ रोकै म॑ राजनीतिक दलऽ के बीच दृश्यमान सहयोग भी ओतने महत्वपूर्ण छेलै ।

पूर्व राजनयिक आ राजनीतिज्ञ नीलम्बर आचार्य कहलनि जे, राजनीतिक प्रतिस्पर्धा, सरकार परिवर्तन, संसदीय बाधा, सड़क पर विरोध आ राजनीतिक कीचड़ सब रोजमर्रा के राजनीति के हिस्सा अछि, मुदा राष्ट्रीय संकट के दौरान एक संग आबय के नेपाल के राजनीतिक संस्कृति के विशिष्ट विशेषता अछि।

“नेपाली राजनीति मे एकटा स्थापित संस्कृति अछि जे जिनका खिलाफ दल चुनाव लड़ने अछि वा सड़क पर विरोध के आयोजन केलक अछि हुनका लेल सेहो सम्मान आ जगह बनेबाक।”

आचार्य कहला जे इ परंपरा 1950 क क्रांति स अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, हमर राजनीतिक संस्कृति सहिष्णुता, संवाद, बातचीत आ सहयोग पर आधारित अछि, दक्षिण एशिया के अन्य देश के तुलना मे नेपाल सरकार आ विपक्ष के बीच परामर्श आ बहुदलीय सहमति बनेबाक स्वस्थ परंपरा विकसित केलक अछि।

एकटा अपेक्षाकृत नव राजनीतिक शक्ति के नेतृत्व केलाक बादो ओहि परंपरा के जारी रखबाक लेल ओ लामिछाने के प्रशंसा सेहो केलनि।

आचार्य कहलनि जे, ई उत्साहजनक अछि जे नव राजनीतिक शक्ति दीर्घकालीन राजनीतिक प्रथा के आगू बढ़ा रहल अछि। “सत्ताधारी दल न॑ ई बैठक बुलाबै के पहल करलकै, जे सही कदम छेलै, आरू विपक्षी दल न॑ अपनऽ मतभेद क॑ एक तरफ करी क॑ उपस्थित होय क॑ भाग लेलकै, जे भी ओतने सराहनीय छै ।”

एकरऽ साथ ही आचार्य न॑ कहलकै कि ऐसनऽ पहल के आदर्श रूप स॑ प्रधानमंत्री के नेतृत्व करलऽ जाय ।

ओ कहला जे हालांकि किछु देरी भेल मुदा प्रधानमंत्री धीरे-धीरे बेसी व्यस्त भ गेल छथि। जे सकारात्मक विकास अछि, मुदा एकरा जारी रखबाक जरूरत अछि।'

संकट सहमति के एकटा लंबा परंपरा

सुनसरी में साम्प्रदायिक कलह के दौरान जे राजनीतिक एकता प्रदर्शित भेल छल ओ नेपाल के आधुनिक राजनीतिक इतिहास में आवर्ती पैटर्न के ताजा उदाहरण मात्र अछि | 2005 केरऽ 12 सूत्री दिल्ली समझदारी, बाद म॑ शांति प्रक्रिया, संविधान लेखन, 2015 केरऽ भूकंप, 2019 म॑ भारत के साथ सीमा विवाद, कोविड-19 महामारी आरू लगातार संवैधानिक संकट सहित प्रमुख मोड़ऽ प॑ राजनीतिक दल न॑ राष्ट्रीय स्थिरता आरू सामाजिक समन्वय के रक्षा लेली लगातार पक्षपातपूर्ण हित क॑ अलग करी देल॑ छै ।

राजा ज्ञानेन्द्र शाह १ फरवरी २००५ मे प्रत्यक्ष शासन ग्रहण केलाक बाद नेपाली कांग्रेस, नेकपा एमाले, नेपाली कांग्रेस (डेमोक्रेटिक), जनमोर्चा नेपाल, नेपाल मजदूर किसान पार्टी, नेपाल सद्भावना पार्टी (आनन्दी देवी) आ संयुक्त वाम मोर्चा नेकपा (माओवादी) सँ मिलिकय सात दलीय गठबंधन केलक, जे ओहि समय मे छल सशस्त्र विद्रोह करब।

गठबंधन कए व्यापक रूप स असंभाव्य मानल जाइत छल । जखन कि सात दल संवैधानिक राजनीतिक व्यवस्था के भीतर संचालित छल, माओवादी एक दशक के सशस्त्र संघर्ष लड़ि रहल छल। संसदीय दल आ विद्रोही के बीच आम बात भेट सकैत अछि से कम लोक के विश्वास छल.

12 सूत्री समझदारी ओहि धारणा कए पलटि देलक।

लोकतंत्र क॑ बहाल करै आरू राजा केरऽ प्रत्यक्ष शासन क॑ समाप्त करै के साझा उद्देश्य स॑ एकजुट होय क॑ सात दलीय गठबंधन आरू माओवादी न॑ एगो साझा राजनीतिक मंच बनैलकै । ई समझौता स॑ २००६ केरऽ जन आंदोलन केरऽ नींव पड़लै, जेकरा स॑ राजतंत्र क॑ सत्ता छोड़ै ल॑ मजबूर करलऽ गेलै, भंग होय गेलऽ प्रतिनिधि सभा क॑ बहाल करलऽ गेलै आरू व्यापक शांति समझौता के रास्ता खुललै, जेकरा स॑ एक दशक स॑ चलै वाला संघर्ष क॑ औपचारिक रूप स॑ समाप्त करी देलऽ गेलै ।

एहि सहमति स माओवादी कए मुख्यधारा क राजनीति मे सेहो आनल गेल आ अंततः नेपाल कए संघीय लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य मे संक्रमण भेल ।

राष्ट्रीय संकट के दौरान राजनीतिक सहयोग के संस्कृति, तथापि, शांति प्रक्रिया सं पहिने के अछि.

1989 मे पंचायत शासनक विरुद्ध आन्दोलन मे गहींर वैचारिक मतभेदक बादो नेपाली कांग्रेस आ संयुक्त वाम मोर्चा एकजुट भ गेल । हुनकऽ संयुक्त आन्दोलन स॑ बहुदलीय लोकतंत्र बहाल होय गेलै, जेकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप दोनों पक्ष के प्रतिनिधित्व करै वाला अंतरिम सरकार, १९९० के संविधान के घोषणा आरू १९९१ म॑ संसदीय चुनाव ।

हालांकि एकरऽ बाद के सालऽ म॑ कांग्रेस आरू कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी सब के कड़ा चुनावी प्रतिद्वंदी बनी गेलै, लेकिन लोकतांत्रिक व्यवस्था म॑ पूर्व लोकतंत्र समर्थक आन्दोलन के विरोध करै वाला पूर्व पंचायत नेता सिनी क॑ समायोजित करलऽ गेलै, जेकरा स॑ बहिष्कार के बजाय समावेश के व्यापक राजनीतिक संस्कृति के झलक मिलै छेलै ।

संविधान-लेखन प्रक्रिया मे सेहो इएह भावना फेर स उभरल।

2008 मे जखन पहिल संविधानसभा बजौल गेल त ओहि साल 28 मई कए राजनीतिक दल सब सर्वसम्मति स राजतंत्र कए समाप्त करबा लेल मतदान केलक । मुदा एहि सहमति स जल्दिये संघीय सीमा, शासन व्यवस्था, चुनावी व्यवस्था, न्यायिक संरचना आ राज्य पुनर्गठन पर कटु विवाद कए जगह भेट गेल।

संविधान सभा केरऽ कार्यकाल कई बार बढ़ाबै के बावजूद राजनीतिक दल अपनऽ मतभेद क॑ दूर करै म॑ विफल रहलै । 27 मई 2012 कए बिना कोनो संविधान पहुंचेने विधानसभा भंग भ गेल, जाहि स गहींर संवैधानिक संकट शुरू भ गेल।

सरकार के नेतृत्व केकरा करबाक चाही या नव चुनाव के देखरेख केकरा करबाक चाही एहि पर कोनो सहमति नहि रहला के कारण अंततः दल सब बैसल मुख्य न्यायाधीश खिल राज रेग्मी के अंतरिम मंत्रिमंडल के नेतृत्व करय लेल नियुक्त क अभूतपूर्व समझौता पर पहुंच गेल।

एहि व्यवस्था पर आलोचना एहि लेल आयल जे एहि स कार्यपालिका आ न्यायपालिका क बीच क अलगाव धुंधला भ गेल। तइयो राजनीतिक दल संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया के संरक्षण के असाधारण उपाय के रूप में एहि प्रस्ताव के स्वीकार केलक। एहि समझौता स 2013 मे दोसर संविधानसभा क चुनाव भ सकल।

25 अप्रैल 2015 कए आयल विनाशकारी भूकंप क बाद राजनीतिक सहमति फेर स महत्वपूर्ण भ गेल।

नव संविधान के सामग्री पर दल सब विभाजित रहला पर सेहो बचाव, राहत आ पुनर्निर्माण के प्रयास पर मिलिकय काज केलक। राजनीतिक स्थिरता बहाल करबाक प्रयास मे नेपाली कांग्रेस, नेकपा एमाले, एकीकृत नेकपा (माओवादी) आ मधेसी जनअधिकार फोरम (लोकतान्त्रिक) ८ जून २०१५ केँ ऐतिहासिक १६ बुँदे सम्झौता पर हस्ताक्षर करैत वर्षों सँ राजनीतिक गतिरोध तोड़ि ओहि वर्ष २० सितम्बर मे नेपालक संविधान जारी करबाक बाट साफ केलक ।

बादक संकट सेहो एहने सहयोगक प्रेरणा देलक।

2015 के बाद लगभग छह महीना के सीमा नाकाबंदी के दौरान राजनीतिक दल एकजुट मोर्चा पेश केलक। मधेशमे उठल चिन्ताके समाधानके लेल २३ जनवरी २०१६के पहिल संवैधानिक संशोधनके संयुक्त रुपमे समर्थन केलक आ बादमे नव संवैधानिक ढाँचामे २०१७मे स्थानीय, प्रान्तीय आ संघीय निर्वाचन करवाक लेल मिलिकय काज केलक ।

एकटा आओर हड़ताली उदाहरण 13 जून 2020 कए आयल, जखन प्रतिनिधि सभा सर्वसम्मति स नेपाल क नक्शा कए अपडेट करि कालापानी, लिपुलेख आ लिम्पियाधुरा कए शामिल करबा लेल संवैधानिक संशोधन कए मंजूरी देलक । एहि संशोधन कए उपस्थित सबटा 258 विधायक समर्थन केलथि, जकर विरोध मे कोनो वोट नहि आयल।

हाल ही म॑ प्रमुख राजनीतिक दल न॑ राजतंत्र केरऽ बहाली के वकालत करै वाला अभियान, दुर्गा प्रसाई के नेतृत्व वाला समूह द्वारा आयोजित प्रदर्शन आरू पदच्युत राजा ज्ञानेन्द्र केरऽ नयका राजनीतिक गतिविधि के खिलाफ रैंक बंद करी क॑ ई कहतें हुअ॑ कहलकै कि संघीय लोकतांत्रिक गणतंत्र केरऽ सुरक्षा पक्षपातपूर्ण प्रतिस्पर्धा स॑ परे छै ।

८ आरू ९ सितम्बर २०२५ केरऽ जेन जेड विद्रोह, जेकरा चलतें एमाले-कांग्रेस गठबंधन केरऽ पतन, पार्टी मुख्यालय आरू वरिष्ठ नेता सिनी के घरऽ प॑ हमला, आरू पूर्व मुख्य न्यायाधीश सुशीला कार्की के नेतृत्व म॑ अंतरिम सरकार के गठन के बाद भी राजनीतिक दल न॑ अंततः संवैधानिक निरंतरता क॑ प्राथमिकता देलकै ।

हालांकि शुरू मे कईटा दल अंतरिम व्यवस्था क संवैधानिकता पर सवाल उठेलक, मुदा बाद मे ओ सब 5 मार्च कए आम चुनाव मे भाग लेबा स पहिने प्रधानमंत्री कार्की आ चुनाव आयोग द्वारा बजाउल गेल परामर्श मे शामिल भ गेल, जाहि स देश कए संवैधानिक शासन मे वापसी मे मदद भेटल।

राजनीतिक विश्लेषक भास्कर गौतम कहलनि जे, नेपालक राजनीतिक संस्कृति विशेष रूप सँ सशस्त्र संघर्ष समाप्त भेलाक बाद सँ पैघ संरचनात्मक संकट सँ उबरबाक लेल संवाद पर बेसी निर्भर रहल अछि।

गौतम कहलनि जे, पिछला साल युवा विद्रोह के बाद पारंपरिक राजनीतिक दल आ नेता के बीच गहींर अविश्वास आ चिंता छल। "तइयो ओहि आरक्षणक बादो अंततः सब कियो चुनाव केँ आगूक बाट बुझि लेलक। कारण सब हितधारक एहि प्रक्रियाक मालिकाना हक लेलक, संक्रमण सफल भेल।"

ओ कहलनि जे नेपाल के अनुभव बहुत रास देश के अनुभव सं विपरीत अछि.

गौतम कहलनि जे, बहुत देश मे संकट राजनीतिक विभाजन के गहींर करैत अछि, नेपाल मे प्रायः संवाद आ सहमति के अवसर पैदा करैत अछि। “कोय भी सरकार अपनऽ विरोधी क॑ दुश्मन के रूप म॑ देखी क॑ असगरे जटिल सामाजिक-राजनीतिक चुनौती के समाधान नै करी सकै छै । संवाद आरू सामूहिक कार्यवाही के ई संस्कृति क॑ संस्थागत करना देश केरऽ दीर्घकालिक स्थिरता लेली जरूरी रहतै।”

title: A gateway to Nepali hospitality - Nepali Times
description: A gateway to Nepali hospitality  Nepali Times

full_article:
Decades ago, Khem Lakai was working in a hotel in Bahrain when he encountered many young Nepali migrant workers. Unlike his job, many were working back-breaking, low-paying unskilled jobs.

The pay was low, and many had paid recruiters hefty sums for which they had to borrow from loan sharks, which they then had to repay with savings. Only after that could they start sending money to families back home.

“When I was in Bahrain, I saw many young Nepalis doing odd jobs for low pay,” recalls Lakai. “I thought that if they only had marketable skills, they would not have such a difficult life and could earn more.”

Lakai had studied hospitality in Switzerland and accumulated considerable skill and experience in many countries by this time.

After witnessing the struggle of his compatriots, the idealistic Lakai made up his mind to return to Nepal and put his experience and contacts in the service of his country.

His goal was simple: provide Nepalis structured hospitality education and training to produce skilled human resources that could contribute to the country’s economy and compete in the global tourism market.

Khem Lakai

Nepalis have an advantage, Lakai says, because guests are traditionally treated with warmth and respect. “Hospitality is more than a service industry here,” he says. “It is part of our culture, a lived experience that can be turned into a pathway to employment.”

The Nepali ethos “अतिथिदेवो भवः” in which guest is god became the foundation for the Global Academy of Tourism and Hospitality Education (GATE) that Lakai would go on to found in Nepal in 2007.

GATE grew to offer a Bachelor’s in International Hospitality Management (BIHM), a Bachelor’s in Professional Hospitality (BPH), and Technical and Further Education (TAFE) programmes.

The professional hospitality course is affiliated with Kathmandu University, while the other programmes are in partnership with international institutions, including an Australian public university.

Alongside degree programmes, the college also runs vocational courses for students from lower-income families. These shorter, skill-based courses are designed to help learners enter the job market more quickly.

“The vocational courses are for those students seeking jobs abroad who cannot afford to enroll in a full-fledged degree course,” Lakai explains. “These skills will give them a leg up overseas and help them earn better livelihoods.”

Lakai believes Nepal must place greater emphasis on polytechnic and skill-based education that can help young people find employment even when formal academic qualifications alone are not enough.

GATE’s alumni are employed in both domestic and international job markets. Graduates have gone on to work across the tourism and hospitality sector in Japan, Australia, Malaysia, and West Asia.

“Students stand much to gain from going abroad to get insight into the global hospitality sector,” Lakai says. “That kind of industry know-how helps them gain valuable experience.”

In Nepal, the college collaborates with leading hotels like The Soaltee, which has employed graduates across its branches.

But Nepal’s hospitality sector faces significant challenges, largely because trained Nepalis emigrate permanently, leading to a shortage of trained professionals in the domestic market.

But this also means there are openings as Nepal’s internal tourism flourishes. And Lakai has also seen a growing number of Nepalis returning after gaining experience abroad and bringing new skills— just like he did many years ago.

HIGH-VALUE TOURISM

Lakai believes Nepal’s hospitality industry needs better planning, especially as it moves towards high-value tourism. Nepal does not need to look too far, the country sits between the two biggest potential sources of visitors: India and China.

High costs of travelling to and within Nepal compared to other nations is another barrier. In most tourist destinations across the world, notes Lakai, visitors tend to spend a smaller share of their budget on transport and more on adventure and experience.

The opposite is true for Nepal, high ticketing and travel costs can leave visitors with comparatively less amount of money to spend on activities once they arrive.

GATE plans to expand its outreach and train more professionals, the college has a branch in Pokhara and aims to expand to other parts of Nepal. Meanwhile, international hospitality institutions have also approached the college for exchange programs.

Nepal’s tourism sector, and the nation, depends heavily on the impressions visitors carry home. Hospitality professionals remain central to the Nepali tourism experience. Travellers may remember Nepal for its mountains and culture, but they also remember its cuisine, and its friendly people.

Lakai’s advice to young professionals entering the hospitality and service sector: find joy in your work so that you make those you serve also happy.

“You need to enjoy your job,” says Lakai. “If there is enjoyment in what you do, work and life are one and the same, and therein lies the balance between personal and professional life.”

दशकों पहिने खेम लकाई बहरीन के एकटा होटल मे काज क रहल छलाह तखन हुनका बहुत रास युवा नेपाली प्रवासी मजदूर के सामना भेलनि। हुनकर नौकरी के विपरीत बहुतो गोटे पीठ तोड़य वाला, कम वेतन वाला अकुशल नौकरी क रहल छलाह.

वेतन कम छल, आ कतेको गोटे नियोक्ता लोकनि कें भारी रकम देने छलाह, जकरा लेल लोन शार्क सं उधार लेबय पड़ैत छलनि, जकरा तखन बचत सं चुकाबय पड़ैत छलनि. एकरऽ बाद ही घरऽ में वापस परिवारऽ क॑ पैसा भेजना शुरू करी सकै छेलै ।

लकाई स्मरण करैत कहैत छथि, “जखन हम बहरीन मे छलहुं त देखलहुं जे कतेको युवा नेपाली कम वेतन पर विषम काज करैत छलाह। “हमरा लागल जे जँ हुनका सभ लग मात्र बाजारू लूरि रहितनि तँ एतेक कठिन जीवन नहि रहतनि आ बेसी कमा सकैत छथि।”

लकाई स्विट्जरलैंड में आतिथ्य के पढ़ाई केने छलाह आ एहि समय तक बहुत रास देश में काफी कौशल आ अनुभव संचित क चुकल छलाह.

अपन हमवतन के संघर्ष के साक्षी बनला के बाद आदर्शवादी लकाई नेपाल वापसी के मन बना लेलक आ अपन अनुभव आ संपर्क के अपन देश के सेवा में राखि लेलक।

हुनकऽ लक्ष्य सरल छेलै कि नेपाली संरचित आतिथ्य शिक्षा आरू प्रशिक्षण प्रदान करी क॑ कुशल मानव संसाधन के उत्पादन करलऽ जाय जे देश केरऽ अर्थव्यवस्था म॑ योगदान द॑ सक॑ आरू वैश्विक पर्यटन बाजार म॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करी सक॑ ।

खेम लकाई

नेपाली के फायदा छै, लकाई कहै छै, कियाकि अतिथि के साथ पारंपरिक रूप स॑ गर्मजोशी आरू सम्मान के व्यवहार करलऽ जाय छै । ओ कहैत छथि जे एहि ठाम आतिथ्य सेवा उद्योग स बेसी अछि। “ई हमर संस्कृति के हिस्सा छै, एकटा जीवित अनुभव छै जेकरा रोजगार के रास्ता में बदलल जा सकै छै।”

नेपाली लोकाचार “अतिथिदेवो भवः” जेकरा म॑ अतिथि भगवान छै, वू ग्लोबल एकेडमी आफ टूरिज्म एंड हॉस्पिटैलिटी एजुकेशन (गेट) केरऽ नींव बनलै जेकरऽ स्थापना लकाई न॑ २००७ म॑ नेपाल म॑ आगू बढ़तै ।

गेट इंटरनेशनल हॉस्पिटैलिटी मैनेजमेंट (बीआईएचएम) मे स्नातक, प्रोफेशनल हॉस्पिटैलिटी (बीपीएच), आ तकनीकी आ आगू कें शिक्षा (टीएएफई) कार्यक्रम मे स्नातक कें पेशकश करय कें लेल बढ़ल.

पेशेवर आतिथ्य पाठ्यक्रम काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय स॑ जुड़लऽ छै, जबकि अन्य कार्यक्रम ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ एगो सार्वजनिक विश्वविद्यालय सहित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संस्थानऽ के साझेदारी म॑ छै ।

डिग्री प्रोग्राम के संग-संग कॉलेज कम आय वाला परिवार के छात्र के लेल वोकेशनल कोर्स सेहो चलाबैत अछि. इ छोट, कौशल आधारित पाठ्यक्रमक कें डिजाइन अइ कें लेल कैल गेल छै की सीखएय वाला कें नौकरी कें बाजार मे जल्दी प्रवेश करय मे मदद मिलय.

लकाई बतबैत छथि, “व्यावसायिक कोर्स ओहि छात्रक लेल अछि जे विदेश मे नौकरी चाहैत छथि जे पूर्ण डिग्री कोर्स मे नामांकन करबाक सामर्थ्य नहि रखैत छथि।” “ई हुनर ​​हुनका विदेश मे पैर ऊपर देत आ बेहतर रोजी-रोटी कमाय मे मदद करत।”

लकाई के मानना ​​छै कि नेपाल क॑ पॉलिटेक्निक आरू कौशल आधारित शिक्षा प॑ अधिक जोर देना चाहियऽ जेकरा स॑ युवा सिनी क॑ रोजगार मिलै म॑ मदद मिल॑ सक॑, भले ही केवल औपचारिक शैक्षणिक योग्यता ही पर्याप्त नै होय ।

गेट केरऽ पूर्व छात्र घरेलू आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय दोनों तरह के नौकरी बाजार म॑ काम करै छै । स्नातक जापान, ऑस्ट्रेलिया, मलेशिया, आरू पश्चिम एशिया म॑ पर्यटन आरू आतिथ्य क्षेत्र भर म॑ काम करै लेली गेलऽ छै ।

लकाई कहैत छथि जे वैश्विक आतिथ्य क्षेत्र क जानकारी लेबा लेल विदेश जेबा स छात्र कए बहुत फायदा होएत अछि। “ओहि तरहक उद्योगक ज्ञान-विज्ञान हुनका मूल्यवान अनुभव प्राप्त करबा मे मदद करैत अछि।”

नेपाल मे कॉलेज द सोलटी सन प्रमुख होटल क संग सहयोग करैत अछि, जे अपन शाखा मे स्नातक कए रोजगार देलक अछि।

लेकिन नेपाल केरऽ आतिथ्य क्षेत्र म॑ काफी चुनौती के सामना करना पड़॑ छै, जेकरऽ मुख्य कारण छै कि प्रशिक्षित नेपाली स्थायी रूप स॑ प्रवास करै छै, जेकरा चलतें घरेलू बाजार म॑ प्रशिक्षित पेशेवरऽ के कमी होय जाय छै ।

लेकिन एकरऽ मतलब ई भी छै कि नेपाल केरऽ आतंरिक पर्यटन केरऽ फल-फूलला के साथ-साथ खुललऽ जगह भी छै । आ लकाई सेहो देखने छथि जे विदेश मे अनुभव प्राप्त कए नव-नव लूरि ल' क' नेपाली लोकनिक बढ़ैत संख्या वापस आबि रहल छथि- ठीक ओहिना जेना कतेको साल पहिने केने छलाह.

उच्च मूल्य के पर्यटन

लकाई के मानब छनि जे नेपाल के आतिथ्य उद्योग के बेहतर योजना के जरूरत अछि, खास क’ जखन ई उच्च मूल्य के पर्यटन दिस बढ़ि रहल अछि. नेपाल क॑ बहुत दूर तक देखै के जरूरत नै छै, ई देश आगंतुकऽ के दू सबसें बड़ऽ संभावित स्रोत भारत आरू चीन के बीच बैठलऽ छै ।

अन्य राष्ट्रक तुलना मे नेपाल आ भीतर यात्राक बेसी खर्च एकटा आओर बाधा अछि । लकाई नोट करै छै कि दुनिया भर केरऽ अधिकांश पर्यटन स्थलऽ म॑ आगंतुक अपनऽ बजट केरऽ कम हिस्सा परिवहन प॑ आरू रोमांच आरू अनुभव प॑ अधिक खर्च करै के प्रवृत्ति रखै छै ।

नेपाल के लेल एकर उल्टा अछि, टिकट आओर यात्रा के बेसी खर्च के कारण आगंतुक के एक बेर पहुंचला पर गतिविधि पर खर्च करय लेल अपेक्षाकृत कम पाई भ सकैत अछि.

गेट अपन आउटरीच विस्तार आ बेसी प्रोफेशनल कए प्रशिक्षित करबाक योजना बना रहल अछि, कॉलेज क शाखा पोखरा मे अछि आ नेपाल क अन्य भाग मे सेहो विस्तार करबाक लक्ष्य अछि। एम्हर अंतरराष्ट्रीय आतिथ्य संस्थान सेहो आदान-प्रदान कार्यक्रम के लेल कॉलेज सं संपर्क केलक अछि.

नेपाल केरऽ पर्यटन क्षेत्र, आरू राष्ट्र, आगंतुकऽ द्वारा घरऽ लेली जाय वाला छापऽ प॑ बहुत निर्भर छै । नेपाली पर्यटन अनुभव मे आतिथ्य व्यवसायी केंद्रीय बनल अछि । यात्री सब नेपाल के पहाड़ आ संस्कृति के लेल याद भ सकैत अछि, मुदा ओकर भोजन, आ ओकर मिलनसार लोक के सेहो याद अछि.

आतिथ्य आरू सेवा क्षेत्र म॑ प्रवेश करै वाला युवा पेशेवरऽ लेली लकाई केरऽ सलाह : अपनऽ काम म॑ खुशी पाबी क॑ जेकरा स॑ आपने सेवा करै छियै ओकरा भी खुश करी सकै छियै ।

लकाई कहैत छथि, “अहाँ केँ अपन काज मे मजा लेबय के जरूरत अछि। “अहाँ जे काज करैत छी ताहि मे जँ आनंद भेटैत अछि त’ काज आ जीवन एके रंग अछि, आ ओहि मे व्यक्तिगत आ पेशेवर जीवनक बीच संतुलन निहित अछि।”

title: Broad Peak avalanche wipes out a generation of Nepali climbing greats - The Kathmandu Post
description: Broad Peak avalanche wipes out a generation of Nepali climbing greats  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
When a massive avalanche swept down Pakistan’s 8,051-metre Broad Peak on Thursday morning, it did more than claim six Nepali lives. It wiped out one of the most accomplished generations of high-altitude climbers the country has produced, taking with it decades of technical expertise, leadership and record-breaking achievement.

Among those killed was world-renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja, widely known as Nimsdai, along with five elite Nepali mountain guides whose experience and skills helped shape modern Himalayan climbing.

According to Nepali expedition operators and mountaineering entrepreneurs, the country has rarely suffered such a concentrated loss of internationally recognised and highly accomplished climbers in a single mountain disaster.

The other Nepali climbers killed in the avalanche were Pur Bahadur Gurung, also known as Yukta; Kili Pemba Sherpa, known as Kilu; Nima Sherpa; Nawang Thendu Sherpa; and Gyaljen Sherpa, known as Gyalu. Most had completed dozens of successful ascents of Everest and other 8,000-metre peaks, with several earning global recognition for their achievements.

Gyalu Sherpa and Nawang Thendu Sherpa were associated with Seven Summit Treks. Pur Bahadur Gurung and Nima Sherpa were senior guides with Nimsdai’s Elite Exped, while Kili Pemba Sherpa was a lead guide with Imagine Nepal.

Gyalu Sherpa, a veteran climber from Okhaldhunga, began his commercial mountaineering career in 2015. Over the years, he built an impressive climbing résumé, summiting Lenin Peak, Mera Peak, Lobuche, Himlung Himal, Cholatse, Manaslu, Kanchenjunga and Everest.

Kanchenjunga held particular significance for him. Earlier this year, he completed another successful ascent of Everest after repeatedly summiting the world’s third-highest peak.

“Gyalu set a Guinness World Record by summiting Kanchenjunga three times in a single season, and he climbed Everest many times,” said Chhang Dawa Sherpa, director of Seven Summit Treks, adding that Gyalu had worked with the company for nearly eight years.

Chhang Dawa said 29-year-old Nawang Thendu Sherpa, who was unmarried, had also begun his professional climbing career with Seven Summit Treks and had quickly established himself as a dependable high-altitude guide.

Among those killed, Kili Pemba Sherpa stood out as one of Nepal’s most accomplished mountaineers.

He was one of the 10 elite Nepali climbers led by Nimsdai who made history on January 16, 2021 by completing the first winter ascent of K2, the world’s second-highest mountain and widely regarded as one of its most technically demanding peaks.

Only weeks before the Broad Peak tragedy, on July 3, Kili Pemba reached the summit of Pakistan’s 8,126-metre Nanga Parbat, completing all 14 of the world’s 8,000-metre peaks. Less than a month after achieving that milestone, he was killed in the avalanche on Broad Peak.

The recovery of his body on Friday sent shockwaves through the Rolwaling Valley in Dolakha, where he was born, and across the international mountaineering community.

Born in 1980 into a modest family in Beding, Gaurishankar Rural Municipality-9, Kili Pemba began working on mountaineering expeditions at the age of 16, joining a Manaslu expedition in 1996 as a support worker.

Although his first attempt to reach the summit ended in failure, the experience strengthened his determination. After years of building technical expertise on smaller peaks, he successfully climbed Manaslu in 2002 and reached the summit of Everest for the first time the following year.

Kili Pemba’s contributions extended well beyond his own climbing record.

In 2021, alongside Mingma Gyalje Sherpa, known as Mingma G, he helped identify the true summit route on Manaslu, resolving a long-standing issue under which many climbers had stopped at a fore-summit instead of the mountain’s highest point. The route they identified has since become the accepted line for expeditions.

He also earned international fame for guiding climbers with disabilities on some of the world’s highest mountains. In 2018, he led Chinese double amputee Xia Boyu to the summit of Everest, and in 2021 guided Russian double amputee Rustam Nabiev to the top of Manaslu.

According to his uncle, Dawa Chirring Sherpa, Kili Pemba had successfully summited Everest 15 times during his career, earning a reputation as one of Nepal’s most skilled and dependable high-altitude guides.

Nima Sherpa, from Chyakse Boda in Makalu Rural Municipality-2 of Sankhuwasabha, was widely regarded as a disciplined, honest and fearless climber. Raised in a farming family, he built a reputation as a dependable high-altitude guide. Working with Elite Exped, Nima had successfully climbed four 8,000-metre peaks this year before joining the Broad Peak expedition.

Pur Bahadur Gurung, widely known as Yukta, had travelled to Pakistan three weeks earlier with the aim of climbing K2. That plan changed after one of his clients broke an arm, forcing the expedition to postpone its K2 attempt. He then joined Nimsdai’s Broad Peak team.

Yukta had already climbed 12 of the world’s 14 mountains above 8,000 metres, leaving his ambition of completing all 14 unfinished.

Three years ago, after completing his seventh ascent of Everest in May, he spoke of his enduring passion for the mountains.

“The moment I head for the mountains, my spirit soars; standing on the summit fills me with pure energy,” he said in an interview.

A native of Laprak in Dharche Rural Municipality-4, Gorkha, Yukta came from a village known for producing accomplished climbers. Six people from Laprak have set records on Everest. He also became the first climber from the Gurung community to summit Everest 10 times.

He first reached the world’s highest peak in 2011 at the age of 22 and completed his tenth ascent on May 20 this year. His climbing record also included successful ascents of Makalu, Annapurna, Lhotse and K2.

Confirmation that his body had been recovered alongside that of Omani climber Nadhira Al Harthy plunged Laprak into mourning.

Nawang Thendu Sherpa was among the youngest guides killed in the avalanche. Though only 29 and unmarried, he had already scored an impressive climbing record, having summited Everest, Lhotse, Manaslu, Kanchenjunga, Makalu and Ama Dablam.

He first climbed Everest in 2022 and reached the summit of Makalu earlier this year.

According to Ongdi Tshering Sherpa, chairman of Makalu Rural Municipality, Nawang came from a family deeply rooted in mountaineering. His father and three brothers are all veteran climbers who have summited 8,000-metre peaks.

“Nawang’s passing deprives our village of a courageous, honest and exceptionally promising young man,” Ongdi said. “His contributions, discipline and dedication will be remembered by Nepal’s mountaineering fraternity for years to come.”

Leaders in Nepal’s mountaineering industry said the deaths represent more than a personal tragedy, warning that the loss of such an experienced group of climbers will have lasting consequences for the country’s adventure tourism sector.

“An international-standard mountain guide cannot be produced overnight,” said Chhang Dawa, director of Seven Summit Treks.

“It takes years of training, repeated expeditions and practical experience. Companies like ours recruit young men from remote Himalayan villages, train them over many seasons and help them become world-class professionals. Losing climbers of this calibre is a devastating blow, not only for Nepal but also for the global mountaineering community.”
